meaning: to tell or ask someone to do something

english.note: For an everyday spoken instruction or command, this is the all-purpose choice.
Use this colloquial verb when telling or ordering someone to do something.

exampleSentences.english: I direct you to stop right now.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 giu3 nei5 ji4 gaa1 ting4 dai1

english.note: Use this casual verb when asking or telling someone to do something.

exampleSentences.english: I request that he watch my bag.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 giu3 keoi5 bong1 ngo5 tai2 zyu6 go3 doi6

english.note: Use 叫 when telling or ordering someone to do something, as in 叫佢走.

exampleSentences.english: I tell him to go home immediately.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 giu3 keoi5 zik1 hak1 faan1 uk1 kei2

english.note: Use 叫 when asking or telling someone to do something, especially in casual speech.

exampleSentences.english: Can you ask him to take a photo for me?
exampleSentences.traditional: 你可唔可以叫佢幫我影張相？
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 giu3 keoi5 bong1 ngo5 jing2 zoeng1 soeng2
